title: Parse: Extract requirements from LCI /msg/inbox
description:
Read spec section, extract MUST/SHALL/SHOULD statements, create checklist in task description

## Extracted Requirements from spec/11-lci.md and spec/12-apps.md

### Resource Discovery (17.5.1)
- MUST advertise: `</msg/inbox>;rt="msg.inbox";ct=60;obs`
- Content-Format (ct=60) = application/cbor
- Observable resource (obs)

### Feature Optionality (17.5.7)
- MAY implement messaging (entire /msg/inbox feature is OPTIONAL)
- MUST NOT advertise legacy Python demo /messages resource as native messaging resource

### Message Format (18.1.1)
Required fields for outbound message:
- `body` (tstr): message text
- `to` (string, optional on POST): recipient IPv6 or "ff02::1" for broadcast
- `ack` (bool, optional): request delivery receipt

Optional fields:
- `priority` (uint, 0=normal, 1=high, 2=emergency)
- `reply_to` (uint): references previous message ID
- `ttl` (uint): message expires after N seconds

Response/inbox message fields:
- `id` (uint): unique message ID
- `from` (string): sender IPv6
- `ts` (uint): Unix timestamp
- `body` (tstr): message text

### Timestamp Requirements (18.1.1)
- SHOULD include `ts` only when time provider reports `wall_clock_valid=true`
- MAY accept messages without `ts` or with `ts=0` as "time unknown"
- SHOULD NOT enforce TTL-based expiry when no valid wall-clock time

### POST /msg/inbox (18.1.2)
- MUST return 2.01 Created on success
- MUST include Location-Path header with /msg/sent/<id>
- MUST support `{"body": ..., "ack": ...}` format
- MUST support canned message format: `{"canned": <id>, "ack": ...}` (18.1.3)
- For broadcast: POST to coap://[ff02::1]/msg/inbox

### GET /msg/inbox (18.1.2)
- MUST support Observe (RFC 7641)
- MUST return Content-Format: application/cbor
- MUST return `{"messages": [...], "unread": N}` format
- Each message in array: `{"id": ..., "from": ..., "ts": ..., "body": ...}`
- New messages MUST trigger Observe notifications

### Delivery Receipts (18.1.2)
- When sender includes `ack: true`:
  - Recipient SHOULD POST to sender's /msg/ack
  - Format: `{"id": ..., "status": "delivered"|"read"|"failed", "ts": ...}`

### Store-and-Forward (18.1.4, OPTIONAL)
If implemented:
- MUST advertise capability via `/.well-known/core?rt=msg.store`
- MUST comply with storage limits (min 8 messages, max 64)
- MUST support at least minimum values for constrained nodes
- MUST NOT starve routing tables or critical functions
- MUST evict in order: expired > per-destination fairness > FIFO
- MUST return 5.03 Service Unavailable when full (with Max-Age)
- MUST return 4.13 Request Entity Too Large for oversized messages
- MUST return 4.03 Forbidden for blacklisted destinations
- MUST return 4.00 Bad Request for TTL too long
close_reason: Extracted all MUST/SHALL/SHOULD/MAY requirements from spec/11-lci.md (17.5.1, 17.5.7) and spec/12-apps.md (18.1.1-18.1.4) into a structured checklist covering: resource discovery, feature optionality, message format fields, timestamp semantics, POST/GET behavior, Observe notifications, delivery receipts, and optional store-and-forward constraints.
